options: The held-out set for an LLM feature: real cases with known-good outcomes, run on every change

stem: Taking the most frequent questions as your set…
options: Erases rare-but-critical slices like security - frequency is not risk
explanation: Stratify with a floor sized by cost-of-error.

options: Mirrors the traffic mix but guarantees every slice a minimum number of cases
explanation: Common cases mirrored; rare-critical cases protected.

options: A checkable expectation plus provenance - not a transcript of the perfect answer
explanation: Many answers are good (2.7); the scorer checks a property.

stem: Labels record who labelled them because…
options: The model must never grade its own eval - that would be circular
explanation: A person or a documented rule, never the system under test.

options: The cases that should refuse or escalate, not just the happy path
explanation: Features fail dangerously exactly on the cases you left out.

stem: Versioning and hashing the set matters because…
options: Numbers from different versions are different numbers - the hash stops silent drift
explanation: 'we added a few cases and the score went up' is meaningless without it.

options: A single flaky case moves the rate by 3+ points - too noisy to gate on
explanation: Start ~50, grow to hundreds; run each several times (8.4).

stem: Generating 500 cases by model-paraphrasing 20 real ones…
options: Shares the 20's blind spots and is labelled by the thing under test - false confidence
explanation: Coverage comes from real, diverse traffic and independent labels.

options: From every production miss and incident, each added with a note
explanation: The set tracks the product; a static set stops describing live traffic.
